decision_conditions: The use of the application site as a children's and young adult home for a maximum of 3 children / young adults and a maximum of 6 people overall in the terms described in the application and additional information received does not result in a material change of use from the existing use as a Class C3 dwelling house, even though the proposed use in itself would partly fall within Use Class C2 of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes Order) 1987 (as amended).  As such, the proposal does not constitute development and so planning permission is not required.

Should the circumstances of the property/occupants and activities change it may be that planning permission would be required. It is the responsibility of the applicant to ensure that the operations associated with 7 Valiant Close, Romford remain lawful.
description: Use of residential house use c3(a) as supported accommodation use
